description:
Short title
AI on batch data

What should the AI do?
management wants us to 'do something with AI' on our batch data this year. could you check what we need to watch out for?

Does the AI output directly affect a batch, a GMP record, a QC result, a release or a process setting?
Not sure

What kind of AI is it?
Not sure

What happens with the output?
Not sure

Who checks the output, and how?
not decided yet

What data goes into it?
Not sure

Who provides it?
Not sure
title: AI on batch data

grid.note: Simplified grid inspired by the GAMP AI adaptiveness × autonomy concept; levels defined in this project.

decision.label: Pending clarification: update any missing or conflicting details below
decision.explanation: The description does not say enough to decide whether the use is GMP-critical or what kind of model it is. Both change the verdict.

citations.quote: This annex applies to all types of computerised systems used in the manufacturing of medicinal products and active substances, where Artificial Intelligence models are used in critical applications with direct impact on patient safety, product quality or data integrity, e.g. to predict or classify data.

judgments.label: GMP, non-critical
judgments.rationale: Keyword baseline: the use is in a GMP setting ('batch') but the output supports people rather than deciding.

citations.quote: If used in non-critical GMP applications, which do not have direct impact on patient safety, product quality or data integrity, personnel with adequate qualification and training should always be responsible for ensuring that the outputs from such models are suitable for the intended use, i.e. a human-in-the-loop…

judgments.label: Unclear
judgments.rationale: Keyword baseline: the description does not give enough information for this field.
judgments.note: Not enough information in the proposal to classify this; see the questions.

judgments.label: AI recommends, human approves each output
judgments.rationale: Keyword baseline: a person reviews or approves each output ('check').

citations.quote: Where a model is used to give an input to a decision made by a human operator (human-in-the-loop), and where the effort to test such model has been diminished, the description of the intended use should include the responsibility of the operator.

open_questions: What kind of model is it: a trained model that is frozen before use, a model that keeps learning in operation, a generative AI / LLM, or fixed rules and scripts?
warnings: Draft Annex 22, the draft Annex 11 and the draft Chapter 4 are consultation drafts (July 2025). The final texts may differ.
